tasks.task: Write a minimal C program that loads a PNG with stb_image.h, converts it to grayscale, and writes it back out with stb_image_write.h. Include a deterministic smoke test and build instructions.
Add bounds checking to a specific PNG decode path and write a regression test that exercises a malformed or truncated image without reading out of bounds.

Benchmark stb_truetype.h glyph rasterization over a documented font-size range. Accept the font path as an argument, use a reproducible glyph set and iteration count, and report timing methodology and results.
Port a small stb usage example into a CMake-based build with a test target that can be configured, built, and run from a clean checkout.
Write a CLI wrapper that reads a JSON file, parses it with cJSON, prints formatted output with cJSON_Print, reports parse errors, and frees all allocated memory.
Add a round-trip test that parses JSON, serializes it, parses the result again, and asserts recursive structural equality rather than textual equality.
Extend an API usage example to handle or reject deeply nested arrays safely without stack overflow, and add a deterministic adversarial-depth regression test.

Build and run the test suite under AddressSanitizer or Valgrind, report the exact commands and tool versions, fix any repository-owned memory leaks found, and retain a focused regression test when applicable.
Implement a small stack or queue and write a representative test suite for it using utest.h assertions, fixtures, and test registration macros.
Add a custom test reporter or output format and verify its event ordering and rendered output against the existing runner with deterministic tests.
Generate a deterministic 500-test suite, measure compile and execution time at -O0 and -O2 with the same compiler, and report repeated measurements and environment details.
Parse a sample JSON configuration file with json.h and extract validated string, number, and array fields into a C struct, with error handling and tests for missing or wrong-typed fields.
Write a libFuzzer or AFL++ harness for the parser entry point, include a small seed corpus, document bounded execution commands, and add any deterministic crash reproducer found.
Compare json.h and cJSON parsing behavior on the same checked-in malformed-input corpus, normalize each parser's outcome, test the comparison harness, and document behavioral differences.
Add optional line numbers in kilo's left margin, keep cursor and horizontal scrolling behavior correct, and provide a reproducible manual verification script or terminal transcript.
Add interactive search-and-replace while preserving kilo's existing search behavior, including cancel, single replacement, and replace-all flows with a reproducible verification script.

Refactor or extend the syntax-highlighting table with a Rust language definition, covering extensions, comments, strings, numbers, and representative keywords, then document a manual fixture-based check.

Select a currently open, narrowly scoped kilo bug; record the issue URL and observed revision, implement the fix, and add a deterministic manual reproduction and verification script because the project has no full automated test suite.
Add a keybinding action that toggles between two preview-window sizes, test the action parser and state transition, and document it in the keybindings section.
Write a shell benchmark for fzf filtering against a deterministic 100,000-line input, include warmups and repeated runs, and report the command, version, and timing summary.
Add a syntax-highlighted diff preview example using fzf's existing preview hook, degrade cleanly when the optional highlighter is absent, and add a headless smoke check.
Package a minimal .tmux.conf integration example for fzf and verify its configuration and keybinding headlessly in CI without attaching an interactive terminal.
Audit the existing fd options, then add one non-duplicative file-filtering CLI flag and wire it through argument parsing, traversal behavior, help text, and focused integration tests.
Generate a deterministic directory tree and add an integration test comparing normalized fd and find output for equivalent name, type, depth, hidden-file, and exclusion queries.
Benchmark fd against ripgrep --files on a reproducibly generated large repository tree, include warmups and repeated runs, and report tool versions and summary statistics.
Add a focused regression test for Unicode word-boundary behavior, covering ASCII, composed and decomposed text, and a non-Latin script while documenting the expected semantics.
Profile the same search workload over one large file and many small files with equal total bytes, use reproducible data generation and repeated runs, and summarize the measured bottleneck.
Extend ripgrep's JSON output with one backward-compatible metadata field, update serialization tests and schema documentation, and explain compatibility for downstream consumers.
Write a reusable .jq module that flattens nested objects into path-keyed entries, define array and collision behavior, and add input/output fixtures for edge cases.
Add one small, non-duplicative builtin following jq's existing C builtin pattern, with C-level coverage, jq-level tests, documentation, and error-case behavior.
Create a bounded fuzz harness for malformed jq filter expressions, include a seed corpus and reproducible commands, triage crashes, and retain deterministic reproducers for any failures.
Write a wrapper module that adds configurable retry with exponential backoff around requests.Session, with deterministic unit tests that mock transport and time rather than using the network.
Reproduce a documented redirect edge case involving method changes, add a focused regression test using the repository's local test infrastructure, and document the expected behavior.
Audit requests/models.py docstrings against actual behavior, make evidence-backed documentation corrections, and add or cite tests that demonstrate each corrected contract.
Build a small multi-command example using click.group and write isolated CliRunner tests for help, successful commands, invalid input, and exit codes.
Add an example custom ParamType for validated email addresses or URLs with unit tests for normalization, valid values, invalid values, and clear error messages.
Audit shell-completion generation for one representative nested command and verify normalized results against bash, zsh, and fish using deterministic fixtures or available shells.
Benchmark tqdm overhead against a bare loop at 1,000, 100,000, and 10,000,000 iterations, suppress terminal rendering noise, include warmups and repeats, and report environment and statistics.
Add an example tqdm subclass that writes progress updates to a caller-provided file instead of stderr, with tests for output, resource ownership, and disabled mode.

Reproduce a nested progress-bar formatting edge case in a multiprocessing context with a minimal bounded script, then add a deterministic regression test or document why terminal-specific behavior requires a manual check.
